atoms.a: King Edward died in 1066 without any children. Why do you think this was a problem?

b.sound: There was no clear heir to the throne of England.
There was no one to go to his funeral.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this conversation to learn why each person thought they should be king.

atoms.b: The throne should be mine! I am one of the ((++most_powerful weakest)) men in England and Edward offered me the throne on his deathbed.
Edward came to Normandy to see me and promised me the ((++throne money))! I should be king!
Well, I am related to Canute, the former King of ((Spain ++England)). It’s only right that I should be the next king!

feedback.finish: Harold Godwinson was crowned King of England by the English nobles. This made William and Harald Hardrada angry, and they both decided to take action.

instruction.text: What do you think William and Harald decided to do next?

atoms.sound: On September 25th 1066, Harald Hardrada and his Viking army invaded Northern England.

atoms.a: King Harold and his army met them at Stamford Bridge, ...
atoms.b: where both sides fought a fierce battle.
atoms.sound: King Harold and his army met them at Stamford Bridge where both sides fought a fierce battle.

atoms.b: Hardrada was killed and the Vikings were defeated.
atoms.sound: Eventually, the Vikings were overwhelmed, Hardrada was killed and the Vikings were defeated.

instruction.text: What do you think were the two consequences of the Battle of Stamford Bridge?

feedback.end: The Battle of Stamford Bridge was the final Viking invasion of England, but it weakened Harold’s army. They were exhausted from marching up the country and fighting hard.
